notes: The 409 the spec documents for POST /vector_stores/{vector_store_id}/file_batches, with its Retry-After ("When this change is blocked by a vector store migration, the number of seconds to wait before retrying"); message invented, ErrorResponse shape. The only 409 the spec documents on an endpoint the gateway proxies (ProxyVectorStoresRequest; nothing else of the vector stores API is parsed). Filed under gpt-6-sol because the request names no model. Needs a store mid-migration.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap O6: the retry-after header is dropped (and retry-after-ms and x-request-id, which openai-python reads too); models.APIError has no retry field, so the gateway retries and fails over on its own schedule instead of when OpenAI says, and the client loses the hint
